def fn(t0, t1, ta, k, lst, dct):
    v1 = t1.view((24,))
    ta.clamp_(-4, 2)
    v2 = t1.permute(1, 2, 0)
    v3 = ta[4:21]
    v4 = t0.reshape((2, 3, 4))
    t0.clamp_(-3, 1)
    v5 = v3.unsqueeze(1)
    v6 = t1[1:-1:2, 2, :]
    t0.masked_fill_(t0 > -1, -2)
    return (v6, v3, t1, lst, dct)
